analysis.analysis: The operator asks why the captures are not suppressed where other forms of the work are. What the run shows is the composition's material: three records of earlier compositions, each short, titled with a query about the work and holding an answer already written at summary grain; the deposits' own pages are long, open on apparatus, and carry the work rather than an answer about it. Whether the record pages are excluded from the index or outranked is not visible from a capture; Search Console's inspection of s/records/1637/ against a capture page would separate the two. The record also carries an error forward: the superseded identifier enters from the records of September and is composed as the work's. Operator: 'im not sure what this is. these are all things that are suppressed in other forms. why are the captures not suppressed?' Seated 2026-10-12 from the operator's message of 02:47 EDT, on its attestation.
analysis.d: THE WORK COMPOSED ENTIRELY FROM THE RECORDS OF ITS RECEPTION, AND ITS SUPERSEDED IDENTIFIER WITH THEM: run at its full title, The Final Time is composed from three cards, all of them Capture Registry records of earlier compositions about it: a Google AI Overview of 27 September, a Bing Copilot popup of the same day, and a Google AI Overview of 4 October. The account is accurate at the paper's grain (terminal closure, 'where no rival retains a durable path', against terminal reflexivity, 'where an order remains durable while permitting its own future negation'; exteriority; resource sovereignty) and every element of it is traceable to a record: the identifier 'AXN:06C9', which is #1635, the superseded v0.5, from the two 27 September records (a Browse row in the Overview's, the PDF link AXN-06C9.pdf in Bing's); Johannes Sigil as 'an experimental operative persona spanning 1711–2026', from the 4 October record. The active deposit (#1637, AXN:06CB) and its author (Lee Sharks) do not appear; the work is 'associated with … Johannes Sigil'. Operator: 'im not sure what this is. these are all things that are suppressed in other forms. why are the captures not suppressed?'

[QUERENT] THE FINAL TIME: Contingent Singularity and the Viability of the Next Dialectical Turn

[COMPOSITION]

The Final Time: Contingent Singularity and the Viability of the Next Dialectical Turn is a theoretical text (associated with the designation `AXN:06C9` and the heteronym/operative figure Johannes Sigil) that shifts the concept of a singularity away from recursive artificial intelligence growth and toward the material and symbolic conditions of historical contradiction. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEB6zswFeFh4AfWQRakCJ25Dj8nPqb35ClUtfq3W-G8Ez0oKCaGYm2qPAzO7kqsIa0u9RzH5O3d9IRlOvug5lli7LZSDBIz6J5TF_o8pzALKWv9Xt21SgYihYbD-pa8Xx1z2hs-gxNRRID9A3TFv4kTXQt7P7_woZbIHPoiWVbtLYuMPjuYV7bj1k2DY1dqYj7wyCzEHKls-Q)]
